<Summary>
WIDE SHOT of the gothic hall matching Picture 2, staircase on the right. The girl matching Picture 1 appears at the upper landing of the spiral staircase and begins descending, one hand on the stone railing. At the end of the shot the camera pushes in toward the staircase, moving closer to her. SHE IS DESCENDING: every step goes DOWN toward the lower hall floor, she never turns back up, never ascends, her back never faces uphill while walking Weather and lighting: dark gothic hall, candle sconces on the stair wall, thin mist. Color grade: cold dark teal-grey with warm candle accents, high contrast, fine grain.

Subject 1: fully_preserved - identical girl, keep hair and black robe exactly as Picture 1, do not alter or reshape the face
Picture 1: fully_preserved
Subject 2: partially_preserved - scene geometry anchor, keep the spiral staircase structure, curve direction, railing and candle sconces exactly consistent with Picture 2; the staircase ascends from the lower hall floor up toward the upper landing exactly as shown in Picture 2

Wide shot. The girl matching Picture 1 steps into view at the upper landing of the spiral staircase and descends several steps, brisk controlled pace, her free hand gliding on the railing. The camera slowly pushes in toward the staircase, framing her tighter by the final second, ending on a medium view of her mid-descent. She continues downward the whole time.
Weather and lighting: dark gothic hall, warm candle sconces along the stair wall, thin mist near the stair base.
Color grade: cold dark teal-grey with warm candle-glow accents, high contrast, fine grain.
All dialogue in Chinese, no other language, no narration.

<Overall Soundscape>
boots on stone steps, robes swishing, hand brushing the railing, candle flames, deep hall ambience

mysterious low strings, restrained
